Title: Public Preview: Azure Cosmos DB Migration for MongoDB extension - Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB vCore migration capability

Body.Content:
The Azure Cosmos DB Migration for MongoDB extension is now enhanced with migration capability for smoother migration of MongoDB workloads to Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB vCore. Easily migrate while accessing incompatibilities and handpick databases and collections for migration. Experience hassle-free transitions with offline migration support, ensuring a smooth move to the new Cosmos DB vCore edition. Upgrade your MongoDB experience today by migrating to Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB vCore.

Learn More.
